item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.28)] Teradyne at Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference: ai push widens
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.28)
Teradyne (TER) outlined its comprehensive AI-driven strategy at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference, highlighting how all three of its main businesses—semiconductor test, robotics, and product test—are benefiting from the AI build-out. CEO Greg Smith emphasized strong momentum across these segments, anticipating a prolonged expansion cycle for the semiconductor industry fueled by hyperscaler demand and increased test intensity. The company aims for significant operating leverage by managing gross margins in the 59-61% range and keeping OpEx growth below half of revenue growth, while also expanding market share in critical AI-related areas like custom silicon and robotics.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.14)] CNBC Daily Open: Apple's new iPhone bends. Bond vigilantes, not so much
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.14)
Apple has unveiled its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, alongside other new devices, priced starting at $1,999. Meanwhile, the U.S. Treasury has tripled its long-dated bond buyback to $6 billion, an extraordinary measure to maintain market liquidity and cap yields, which nevertheless saw yields rise and stocks fall. Amidst global market jolts from the Hormuz conflict, President Donald Trump's energy portfolio has significantly increased in value.

item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.62)] AI NEWS—W.D. Wash.: Complaint alleges Microsoft D&Os misled about AI strategy, copyright violations
item.description:

A complaint has been filed in the Western District of Washington alleging that Microsoft's Directors and Officers misled investors regarding the company's AI strategy. The complaint also includes accusations of copyright violations related to their AI initiatives.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.21)] Private cloud modernization insights from VMware Explore
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.21)
This article highlights three key insights from VMware Explore regarding private cloud modernization. It emphasizes its role as a foundation for production AI, the need for tight controls and flexible placement for production workloads, and the crucial role of partners in deploying integrated private cloud solutions. The discussions cover the importance of software-defined infrastructure, security for agentic AI, and cost-effective hardware configurations for AI workloads.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.34), AMZN Bullish (+0.44)] Want in on Anthropic Before the IPO? Buy These 8 Stocks
item.description:

Anthropic is reportedly preparing for an IPO with a target valuation near $2 trillion. While direct investment isn't yet possible for retail investors, this article highlights eight publicly traded companies that hold direct equity stakes in Anthropic. These companies include major tech players like Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Nvidia, as well as Salesforce, Zoom, SK Telecom, and ServiceNow, offering indirect exposure to Anthropic's potential growth.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.02)] Is Salesforce (CRM)’s Agentforce Growth Enough to Outpace F5 (FFIV)’s AI Security Momentum?
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.02)
The article compares the growth trajectories and financial performance of Salesforce (CRM) and F5 (FFIV) in the enterprise software market, particularly focusing on AI security and agentic AI capabilities. While both companies show strong execution and profitability, Salesforce is highlighted as the stronger financial compounder due to its larger recurring revenue base and role in enterprise AI orchestration, despite F5's specialized AI security offerings. Investors are advised to monitor F5's software growth from its MuleSoft integration and Salesforce's ability to convert Agentforce activity into higher net new annual order value.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.12)] Quanta Services, Inc. Announces Appointment of Ellen Rubin to Board of Directors
item.description:

Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE: PWR) has announced the appointment of Ellen Rubin to its Board of Directors. Ms. Rubin brings extensive experience in AI, cloud services, and enterprise technology, having held leadership roles at Glasswing Ventures LLC, Causely, Inc., Amazon Web Services, and ClearSky Data, Inc. She also currently serves on the board of Allegion plc.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.14)] Daily Digest: Apple rolls out new iPhone, Anthropic researcher quits
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.14)
Apple Inc. unveiled its new iPhone and other products at its annual fall event in Cupertino. In other news, an Anthropic researcher has reportedly quit the company, and Oakland-based Block Inc. has applied to establish an uninsured national trust bank.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.42)] Amazon's $60B Qualcomm deal expands AI inference hardware
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.42)
Amazon and Qualcomm have entered a $60 billion deal to develop custom silicon and high-speed optical connectivity for AI inference, aiming to optimize AI hardware and manage rising data center costs. This multi-generational partnership will provide AWS users and data center operators with new specialized infrastructure options, focusing on power efficiency for inference workloads. The agreement signifies Amazon's long-term hardware strategy and Qualcomm's expansion into the broader data center market with integrated compute and connectivity solutions.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.13)] Applied Materials CEO: Growth is driven by AI compute demand
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.13)
Gary Dickerson, CEO of Applied Materials, discusses the company's business outlook. He highlights that the growth of Applied Materials is primarily fueled by the increasing demand for AI compute. This indicates a strong connection between advancements in artificial intelligence and the semiconductor industry.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.11)] Optivels Launches New Integration Tools Connecting Shopify, Amazon, and Walmart Stores
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.11)
Optivels, a fulfillment platform for e-commerce and distribution businesses, has introduced new integration tools that significantly reduce setup time for clients onboarding multiple sales channels like Shopify, Amazon, and Walmart. These tools cut store setup time by 25% by allowing merchants to configure their various storefronts through a single process instead of separate ones. This innovation streamlines inventory syncing and order status updates across connected channels, addressing the repetition that previously slowed down multi-channel onboarding.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.13), NVDA Neutral (+0.13)] Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) "Useful Yield" Push Puts NVIDIA's (NASDAQ: NVDA) AI Economics To The Test
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.13), NVDA Neutral (+0.13)
Microsoft is advocating for a "useful yield" approach to AI infrastructure, emphasizing efficiency per dollar and watt, which could significantly impact NVIDIA's AI economics. While Microsoft is optimizing its Azure hardware with custom designs, creating potential competitive pressure for third-party suppliers like NVIDIA, both companies remain commercially intertwined and could benefit from overall AI infrastructure growth. The challenge for both lies in translating lower technical costs into profitable services and attractive economics for shareholders.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.14)] Charles Schwab, Bitwise’s First $1B ETF, and SGP-0002: Solana’s Wall Street August 2026
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.14)
August 2026 marked a significant period for Solana, characterized by major institutional integrations and strong on-chain performance. Charles Schwab enabled SOL trading for its nearly 40 million accounts, while Bitwise's Solana ETF (BSOL) became the first Solana ETF to surpass $1 billion in assets under management. Additionally, Solana's first on-chain governance vote for SGP-0002 passed, doubling the SOL disinflation rate and solidifying its governance framework.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.24)] AT&T CEO John Stankey on $1,999 Apple iPhone Duo: 'This is not new'
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.24)
AT&T CEO John Stankey commented on Apple's new $1,999 iPhone Duo, stating that foldable phones are "not new" as similar devices have been available in the Android market for years. He believes there's a niche audience for such devices but questions whether iOS users will widely adopt it or if Apple's unique approach will change the penetration dynamic. Stankey acknowledged the value for users who desire a larger device and are willing to invest more.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.41)] Apple debuts Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.41)
Apple unveiled its new Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, alongside AirPods 5, during its annual fall event. The new smartwatches feature improved heart rate tracking, a readiness feature, and new sound recognition capabilities, while the AirPods 5 boast enhanced sound, advanced noise cancellation, and Siri AI integration for real-time translation. These updates aim to provide users with more comprehensive health monitoring, convenience, and an elevated audio experience.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.22)] Apple's foldable iPhone is a pivotal test of the company's power
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.22)
Apple has unveiled its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, priced at $1,999. This launch is considered a pivotal moment for Apple, as the market and consumers will assess whether the company still possesses its innovative edge, especially in the face of inflation and supply chain challenges. The success of the iPhone Duo will be measured not only by sales figures but also by its ability to redefine a product category and reaffirm Apple's cultural influence.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.41)] HP Extends Data-Center AI Architecture to the Edge
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.41)
HP Inc. announced a collaboration with Red Hat and NVIDIA to extend enterprise AI capabilities from the data center to the edge. This partnership introduces HP ZGX Fury, powered by the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip, and an open, enterprise-grade AI platform leveraging Red Hat AI Factory with NVIDIA. The solution aims to enable organizations to deploy and manage virtualized AI workloads closer to operations, addressing challenges like latency, privacy, and data sovereignty across various industries.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.03), NVDA Neutral (+0.01)] Braiin (NASDAQ:BRAI) Trading Up 5.2% - What's Next?
item.description:

Braiin (NASDAQ:BRAI) stock saw a 5.2% increase during Wednesday's mid-day trading, reaching $5.73, although trading volume was 95% below its average, indicating limited activity behind the rise. The company specializes in AI/ML solutions for agriculture, property technology, and customer experience, with recent neuroscience headlines having no direct disclosed connection to its operations.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.11)] CEO Switch at Omnicom Advertising As Robertson Succeeds Ruhanen
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.11)
Troy Ruhanen, the President and CEO of Omnicom Advertising, is retiring and will be replaced by Andrew Robertson, currently Chairman of BBDO Worldwide. Omnicom Advertising was established in mid-2024 following an IPG acquisition and oversees global ad networks like BBDO, TBWA, and McCann, along with the US Advertising Collective. Omnicom CEO John Wren praised Ruhanen's leadership in integrating the combined organization and serving clients.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.12)] Apple hikes iPhone prices by $100
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.12)
Apple announced a $100 price hike for its new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models, which will now start at $1,199 and $1,299 respectively. This increase is attributed to higher memory prices. The new iPhones will be available in various storage configurations and colors, with Apple also offering discounts and a leasing program.

item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.37)] Serial Microsoft 0-day hunter drops yet another Defender exploit
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.37)
A prolific zero-day researcher, known as Nightmare Eclipse or MSNightmare, has released a new Microsoft Defender exploit called ShieldCrash. This exploit, which allows arbitrary file reads as SYSTEM, is a bypass of a previous patch for another of Nightmare's zero-days, ShieldBreak, continuing a series of vulnerabilities found in Microsoft products. The researcher has also recently identified bugs in other security vendors' software, including CrowdStrike, Kaspersky, and Gen Digital's Avast.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.10)] Telus files $1M lawsuit alleging ex-director used corporate cards for 2,500 Amazon orders — then resold the goods
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.10)
Telus is suing a former director, Raymond Chow, for over $1 million, alleging he used corporate credit cards to make over 2,500 unauthorized Amazon purchases between 2020 and 2024. The lawsuit claims Chow directed employees to make purchases, approved his own expense claims, and then resold the items for personal profit. Telus is seeking the misappropriated funds plus damages, asserting Chow breached his fiduciary duty.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.34), NVDA Bullish (+0.27)] GitHub tests multi-model routing with HydraFusion
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.34), NVDA Bullish (+0.27)
GitHub is testing HydraFusion, a new multi-model router for its Copilot AI assistant, to optimize workflows by dynamically selecting models based on developer input. This tool aims to balance output quality with AI costs, which is crucial for enterprises facing rising token costs. HydraFusion builds on GitHub's previous Auto model selection and introduces sophisticated orchestration patterns like "Single," "Cascade," and "Critique" to efficiently handle tasks.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.13)] Key enterprise strategies for AI agent observability
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.13)
As enterprises increasingly adopt autonomous AI agents, comprehensive observability becomes critical. This article outlines three pillars of AI agent observability: intent, method, and outcome, emphasizing that traditional monitoring falls short. It details how monitoring these aspects provides faster diagnosis, improved reliability, greater control, and proof of business value for AI agent deployments.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.29)] Corning, Inc. announces multi-billion Verizon partnership
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.29)
Corning Inc. has secured a multi-billion-dollar agreement with Verizon to supply over 80 million miles of high-density optical fiber and connectivity solutions between 2027 and 2032. This partnership aims to accelerate broadband expansion for homes and businesses, support AI hyperscalers with a national long-haul backbone, and enhance Verizon's fiber-to-the-home initiatives, leveraging Corning's manufacturing facilities in the southern United States. The collaboration builds on 30 years of partnership between the two companies and emphasizes the crucial role of fiber in the AI era.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] Amkor is taking its Arizona chip packaging campus to $12bn
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.33)
Amkor Technology is significantly expanding its chip packaging campus in Peoria, Arizona, with the project's total investment now estimated at $12 billion, six times its initial 2023 announcement. This expansion, driven by high customer demand, will add 60,000 square meters of cleanroom space, bringing the total to 93,000 square meters and creating over 3,500 jobs. The project is backed by Amkor's capital, $407 million in US CHIPS Act funding, and a $1.5 billion prepayment from Nvidia, with key customers including Apple, TSMC, and Nvidia.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.13)] Sempra Energy stock hits 52-week low at 19.88 USD By Investing.com
item.description:

Sempra Energy's stock has dropped to a 52-week low of $19.88, marking a 17% decrease from its 52-week high of $23.84. The $55.89 billion energy company has seen its stock decline by 9.92% over the past year. Despite the downturn, InvestingPro rates the company with a "FAIR" financial health score, with a P/E ratio of 24.23.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.15)] Microsoft-Activision Deal Challengers Seek $60 Million Legal Fee
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (-0.15)
Attorneys who negotiated a $250 million class action settlement regarding Microsoft's acquisition of Activision Blizzard are seeking $60 million in legal fees. The settlement addresses claims that former Activision CEO Bobby Kotick and the board approved a discounted sale to escape a sexual harassment crisis. If approved, the fees would represent 24% of the total recovery, drawing attention in a legal community divided over large lawyer paydays.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.21)] AMD Rises 3% as CFO Lifts AI Chip Market Forecast Toward $3 Trillion; Intel Ticks Up
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.21)
AMD's stock rose 3% after its CFO, Jean Hu, increased the company's AI chip market forecast to potentially $3 trillion by 2030, reinforcing TSMC as its primary wafer supplier and sidelining Intel Foundry. Despite a high trailing P/E ratio of 129x, analyst sentiment for AMD is bullish, with significant upward revisions to future EPS estimates. The company's Data Center segment saw a 107% year-over-year revenue jump in Q2 2026, signaling strong demand for its AI products.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (-0.14)] Tradr’s New AXTQ Pays Double When AXT Falls. The Catch Is the Word Daily
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (-0.14)
Tradr has launched a new exchange-traded fund, AXTQ, which aims to double the inverse daily performance of AXT Inc. (AXTI) stock. While this offers leveraged gains when AXTI falls, the "daily" reset mechanism can lead to significant value erosion over longer periods due to volatility decay. The fund is designed for sophisticated short-term traders, not long-term investors, given the high risks and potential for complete loss with large adverse moves in the underlying stock.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.34)] Apple event live updates: First foldable iPhone, new watch series expected as Ternus makes debut
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.34)
Apple is holding its "Surprise and shine" launch event, where new iPhone models, including its first folding phone, and new Apple Watches are expected. This marks the debut event for new CEO John Ternus, and investors are watching for potential price increases and new AI software like Siri AI and Apple Intelligence. Rivals like Huawei and Xiaomi have already launched new foldable phones, intensifying competition in the market.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.11)] Builders FirstSource stock hits 52-week low at 62.25 USD
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.11)
Builders FirstSource (BLDR) stock has dropped to a 52-week low of $62.25, significantly below its high of $148.91 and its InvestingPro Fair Value of $72.35. The decline is attributed to a weak housing market, lower selling prices, and increased fuel costs, leading 20 analysts to revise earnings downwards. The company also announced a key executive departure and reported Q2 2026 earnings below Wall Street expectations.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.46)] HP Inc. Announces Collaboration With Red Hat And NVIDIA To Deliver Enterprise AI Platform And Launches HP ZGX Fury
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.46)
HP Inc. has partnered with Red Hat and NVIDIA to create an open, enterprise-grade AI platform designed to offer flexibility in running AI workloads. This platform, leveraging Red Hat AI Factory with NVIDIA and the new HP ZGX Fury, aims to maximize AI inference throughput, reduce setup time, and improve GPU utilization. The HP ZGX Fury, based on the NVIDIA DGX Station platform, is now available to order and is certified to run on Red Hat Enterprise Linux.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.16)] Bernstein reiterates ServiceNow stock rating on AI growth outlook
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.16)
Bernstein SocGen Group has reiterated an Outperform rating and a $248.00 price target for ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) stock, citing the company's strong AI growth outlook. ServiceNow's AI strategy, including new product packaging and updated long-term guidance of $30-32 billion in annual contract value by 2030 with a significant AI contribution, underpins this positive outlook. Despite some customer grumbling noted in a CIO roundtable, Bernstein believes the company's AI-derived ACV target of over $9 billion by 2030 is achievable, supported by robust revenue growth and gross profit margins.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.20)] U.S. to Lend $1.9 Billion to Restart a Shuttered Nuclear Plant in Iowa
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.20)
The U.S. Energy Department plans to lend NextEra Energy up to $1.9 billion to restart the Duane Arnold nuclear power plant in Iowa, which ceased operations in 2020. This move is part of the Trump administration's effort to revive nuclear energy, with Google agreeing to purchase a portion of the plant's electricity for its data centers. This initiative follows similar federal loans for restarting other shuttered nuclear plants, highlighting a broader trend of renewed interest in nuclear power due to climate change concerns and increasing electricity demand from tech companies.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.41)] HP Extends Data-Center AI Architecture to the Edge
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.41)
HP has announced a collaboration with Red Hat and NVIDIA to extend enterprise AI capabilities from the data center to the edge. This partnership aims to create an open, enterprise-grade AI platform combining HP ZGX Fury with Red Hat AI Factory and NVIDIA technology, designed to run AI inference closer to users and data. The initiative seeks to improve local AI inference throughput, reduce setup time, and enhance GPU utilization for various industries.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Bullish (+0.32)] StoneX reiterates Qualcomm stock buy rating on Amazon partnership
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Bullish (+0.32)
StoneX has reiterated a buy rating and a $270.00 price target for Qualcomm (NASDAQ: QCOM) following its new partnership with Amazon. This collaboration involves customized silicon for AI inference and optical connectivity, materially validating Qualcomm's data-center platform. Despite varying analyst perspectives, the firm maintains its positive outlook, highlighting Qualcomm's diversification beyond mobile chips and its stock's apparent undervaluation.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.22), AMZN Bullish (+0.25)] Gartner: Hyperscalers can't be budged as compute surge matched by cloud services
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.22), AMZN Bullish (+0.25)
Gartner's latest Magic Quadrant for container management indicates that the "big three" hyperscalers—Google, Microsoft, and AWS—maintain their leadership due to enterprise-grade standardization for AI and distributed fleets. While each leader has strengths in AI and execution, they also face individual challenges such as integration complexity or fragmented strategies. The report also highlights other players like Huawei, Alibaba, Red Hat, and SUSE, along with "challengers" including Tencent, Nutanix, and Broadcom, assessing their progress and specific capabilities in the evolving cloud and container management landscape.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.12)] AMD Rises 8% in a Month: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.12)
Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares have risen 7.7% in the past month, outperforming peers, driven by strong growth in its Data Center segment, especially EPYC server CPUs and Instinct GPUs for AI. While AMD has strong growth prospects in the rapidly expanding AI infrastructure market, it faces stiff competition, supply constraints, and potential gross-margin pressure. Despite the positive outlook and recent stock momentum, its premium valuation suggests investors should consider waiting for a more attractive entry point, as the stock currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.07), NVDA Neutral (+0.14), AMZN Neutral (+0.09)] GOOGL Stock Slides As Legal Risks Mount And AI Battle Heats Up
item.category: MSFT Neutral (+0.07), NVDA Neutral (+0.14), AMZN Neutral (+0.09)
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.07), NVDA Neutral (+0.14), AMZN Neutral (+0.09)
Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) stock has fallen by 2.2% due to increasing legal risks concerning its ad business, intensified AI competition, and broader macro pressures affecting growth stocks. Thousands of lawsuits related to platform addiction and youth safety are proceeding, creating headline overhangs and potential valuation compression. Additionally, rising AI competition from products like OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads and the potential acquisition of Hugging Face by Nvidia are challenging Google's dominance, while macroeconomic factors like high oil prices and inflation are impacting tech stocks across the board.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (-0.12)] Cantor Fitzgerald reiterates Microchip Technology stock rating on analog sector strength
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (-0.12)
Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated an Overweight rating and $125 price target for Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP), citing strengthening cyclical trends in the analog semiconductor sector. Despite soft end-demand in non-AI markets, AI is driving recovery, with 16 analysts revising earnings upwards and revenue projected to grow 36% in fiscal 2027. The company recently surpassed Q1 earnings expectations, though UBS lowered its price target due to inventory concerns.

HP has announced a collaboration with Red Hat and NVIDIA to extend its data-center AI architecture to the edge. item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.23)] Forget Oklo: This Nuclear Stock Could Be the Better Buy
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.23)
The article compares two nuclear energy stocks, Oklo (OKLO) and NuScale Power (SMR), in the context of the growing demand for energy from AI data centers. While Oklo has strong industry backing and influential investors, its $8 billion valuation is questioned due to ongoing regulatory approval issues. NuScale, despite a lower market cap, has regulatory approval and is close to a significant power purchase agreement that could validate its commercialization strategy and offer more near-term upside.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.35)] Apple iPhone 18 event: How to watch live, global start times, iOS 27 release date, foldable phone, and more
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.35)
Apple is set to unveil its new iPhone 18 lineup, including a potential first foldable iPhone, as well as new wearables, home products, and software like iOS 27. Viewers can tune in to see updates on the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, Apple Watch Ultra 4, Apple Watch Series 12, and possibly new Apple TV, HomePods, and the "HomePad."

item.description:

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.05)] Integrated Wealth Concepts LLC Has $36.56 Million Stake in Walmart Inc. $WMT

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.08), MSFT Neutral (+0.04)] Apple’s Foldable iPhone Could Become The ‘Birkin Of Smartphones’ In China, Analyst Says – But Others Think The Odds Are 4 To 1 Against The Company
item.description:

Apple is set to unveil its first foldable iPhone, with one analyst predicting it could become a luxury status symbol in China despite a high starting price of $2,199. However, not all on Wall Street are convinced, with a Needham analyst maintaining a 'Hold' rating and expressing concerns about Apple's AI strategy and reliance on Google Gemini, estimating the odds are 4 to 1 against the company. The launch marks the first major product event under new CEO John Ternus.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.35)] Apple's foldable iPhone Ultra set for reveal at 'surprise and shine' event
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.35)
Apple is expected to unveil its first foldable device, the iPhone Ultra, at its "surprise and shine" event today. This event is significant not only for the new product launch but also as the first product launch under new CEO John Ternus, succeeding Tim Cook. The company is also anticipated to reveal the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, new AirPods 5, and updates to the Apple Watch series, with high expectations surrounding Apple's delayed entry into the foldable phone market.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.21)] CCTech Launches Data Exchange Connector for PTC Creo on Autodesk Platform Services
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.21)
CCTech has launched a Data Exchange Connector for PTC Creo, built on Autodesk Platform Services, to enable seamless, bi-directional data sharing between PTC Creo Parametric and the Autodesk ecosystem. This connector addresses the challenges of traditional monolithic file transfers in engineering collaboration by allowing granular, cloud-based publishing of 3D geometry and metadata, improving interoperability between MCAD and BIM workflows. The solution aims to eliminate file-translation friction, protect intellectual property, and establish a shared single source of truth for cross-disciplinary engineering teams.

item.title: [TSM Neutral (+0.03)] Why Taiwan’s Silicon Shield Is Failing
item.description:
Sentiment: TSM Neutral (+0.03)
Taiwan's "silicon shield," stemming from its dominance in advanced semiconductor manufacturing, is facing challenges as China invests heavily in chip self-reliance, particularly in mature-node chips. While Taiwan still holds leverage in cutting-edge chips, China's increasing capacity in 28-nanometer chips threatens to make Taiwan's shield irrelevant for its own economy, potentially leading to a more fragile global trade environment with rising chip prices. This shift means that the geopolitical importance of Taiwan's chip production will no longer solely rely on the most advanced technologies, but also on the control of common chip manufacturing.

This manufacturing strategy is similar to Nvidia's, with TSMC also producing chips for other major tech companies like Apple and Tesla.
